decisions.reason: As a newly launched, close-to-core upholstery fabric with its own product page, it is a low-cost option whose market potential is still unfolding and not yet negative enough to abandon.

This decorative fabric is adjacent to the core range and still early in its life, but its lighter website presence suggests somewhat weaker commitment and therefore a moderate pruning risk rather than an immediate drop.
Its flame-retardant functionality fits the firm's contract-textile strengths and dedicated presentation indicates enough strategic promise to keep the option open.
We would retain it for another year because it builds on the existing offer, yet its more niche wool-blend profile and limited visibility make it more exposed to later portfolio rationalization.

The product is still too new to judge conclusively, but its niche semi-transparent wool bouclé leno character, lighter website support and possible fit issues with simpler recyclable material goals raise the chance of withdrawal.
